import importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('codec', '/inputs/codec.py')
codec = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(codec)

x = 'a a'
once = codec.canonicalize_url(x)
twice = codec.canonicalize_url(once)

assert once != twice, (x, once, twice)

out = {'input': x, 'once': once, 'twice': twice}
Path('/work/counterexample.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=True))
